name: cocosair
description: Route AIR tasks by subsystem or visual symptom; choose direct dependencies and check capabilities.

name: cocosair-2d-subsystems
description: Build DragonBones, TiledMap, particles and billboards from runtime data. Use for raw asset strings, missing pixels, MotionStreak or Spine backend limits.

name: cocosair-agent-session
description: Inspect live scenes and frames with devtools; read runtime diagnostics. Use for scoped session writes, pixel probes or duplicate requestId INVALID_ARGUMENT errors.

name: cocosair-animation-tween
description: Animate tweens and AnimationClip tracks with one step clock. Use to loop a sequence on a target, reverseTime, clean up playback or diagnose unavailable pose graphs.

name: cocosair-application
description: Configure createAirApp options, canvas, lifecycle, screen sizing and context health. Use for WEBGL2_REQUIRED startup errors, scene replacement, session cleanup or lost contexts.

name: cocosair-assets
description: Load asset URL textures, atlases and BMFont with AssetBank. Use for refcounted disposal, extension selection, cache reuse or AIR_E_ATLAS_IN_USE/AIR_E_FNT_IN_USE cleanup.

name: cocosair-audio-video
description: Play media with AudioService, VideoPlayer and WebView. Use for silent autoplay, advancing currentTime, BGM/SFX channels or DOM video and iframe overlays.

name: cocosair-camera
description: Configure Camera projection, viewports, framing and screen/world conversion. Use for split-screen, pointer rays, wrong screenToWorld results or AIR_E_ORTHO_WIDTH.

name: cocosair-gltf
description: Load glTF/GLB models, extensions, decoder injection and instances. Use for Draco/meshopt/KTX2 deployment, GLTF_DECODER_MISSING, uncoded load errors or animation loops.

name: cocosair-graphics-and-dom
description: Draw Graphics/SVG shapes and sprite masks; align a DOM overlay with UI/canvas nodes. Use for overlay placement, input interception, experimental HTML textures or AirUIMesh.

name: cocosair-input-action
description: Wire keyboard, mouse, touch and action state; navigate SceneStack pages. Use for focus, held-key resets, session gates, DOM canvas errors or persistent push/pop.

name: cocosair-materials-effects
description: Configure materials, effects, uniforms, defines and GLSL. Diagnose black/invisible effects, missing textures, setProperty, AIR_E_MATERIAL_NOT_READY or AIR_E_MATERIAL_TYPE.

name: cocosair-math
description: Compute vectors, matrices, quaternions, colors and easing. Use for out-first math, frozen Vec3.UP errors, transform composition, rotation units or Mat4.invert.

name: cocosair-performance
description: Optimize draw calls with static merge, instancing and dynamic atlases. Use for frame budgets, on-demand rendering, AIR_E_MESH_CAPACITY or AIR_E_PIXEL_RATIO_IMPORT_ORDER.

name: cocosair-physics
description: Choose builtin, cannon or Box2D physics; wire rigid bodies, colliders and raycasts. Use for missing gravity, trigger filters, backend limits or material error 9642.

name: cocosair-primitives-mesh
description: Build primitive geometry, Mesh buffers and MeshRenderer bindings. Use for vertex attributes, indices, wireframes or AIR_E_PRIMITIVE_DESCRIPTOR validation.

name: cocosair-project-setup
description: Set up npm imports, package entries, importmap, TypeScript and variant builds. Use for cocosair.js installation, unresolved-import errors, page shells or build artifacts.

name: cocosair-rendering
description: Configure lighting, shadows, render targets, MSAA and sRGB. Use for offscreen pixels, post-processing, AIR_E_RENDER_TARGET_SAMPLES or AIR_E_TEXTURE_COLOR.

name: cocosair-scene-graph
description: Build Scene/Node hierarchies, Component lifecycles, layers and events. Use for reparenting, active inheritance, NodePool reuse, scene globals or resource release.

name: cocosair-skinning-morph
description: Bind skeletons, restore bind poses and drive morph weights. Use for realtime/baked deformation, AIR_E_SKINNING_JOINT_PATH or AIR_E_SKINNING_CAPACITY.

name: cocosair-ui-2d
description: Build Canvas UI with sprites, Label text, layout and widgets. Use for missing UI, viewport alignment, 2D draw order, BMFont binding or AIR_E_LABEL_WRAP.

name: cocosair-verification
description: Choose verification gates and assess browser/package evidence, write behavior and fingerprints. Use to validate changes, distinguish FAIL/UNSUPPORTED or check release readiness.

answer_checks.criterion: Distinguish directional illuminance in Lux from local-light luminousFlux/luminance and nt2lm size conversion; do not use a universal brightness scalar.
answer_checks.evidence: 1. 亮度与单位：DirectionalLight.illuminance 使用 Lux（lx）；HDR 默认值为 65000，HDR 写入为 illuminance × camera.exposure；LDR 使用独立的 illuminanceLDR 槽，不再乘曝光。Ambient.skyIllum 同样在 HDR 乘曝光、LDR 不乘。不要把 HDR 与 LDR 的标量直接混用。Point/Sphere/Spot 使用 luminance 或 luminousFlux；HDR 的 luminousFlux 先除以 nt2lm(size)，其中 nt2lm(size)=4×PI×PI×size²，再按 luminance × camera.exposure × standardLightMeterScale 写入，standardLightMeterScale=10000；LDR 使用自身标量。Point 的 luminousFlux 换算使用 size=1，Sphere/Spot 使用自身 size。Light.color 要传 Color 实例，组件 RGB 通道范围为 0..255。依据：[lighting-units.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/lighting-units.md)。

answer_checks.criterion: Explain HDR/LDR slot, camera exposure and local-light meter-scale differences with the required preconditions.
answer_checks.evidence: 1. 亮度与单位：DirectionalLight.illuminance 使用 Lux（lx）；HDR 默认值为 65000，HDR 写入为 illuminance × camera.exposure；LDR 使用独立的 illuminanceLDR 槽，不再乘曝光。Ambient.skyIllum 同样在 HDR 乘曝光、LDR 不乘。不要把 HDR 与 LDR 的标量直接混用。Point/Sphere/Spot 使用 luminance 或 luminousFlux；HDR 的 luminousFlux 先除以 nt2lm(size)，其中 nt2lm(size)=4×PI×PI×size²，再按 luminance × camera.exposure × standardLightMeterScale 写入，standardLightMeterScale=10000；LDR 使用自身标量。Point 的 luminousFlux 换算使用 size=1，Sphere/Spot 使用自身 size。Light.color 要传 Color 实例，组件 RGB 通道范围为 0..255。依据：[lighting-units.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/lighting-units.md)。

answer_checks.criterion: Ordinary directionals share one effective scene.renderScene.mainLight; inspect its identity, rather than expecting an added ordinary directional to provide fill.
answer_checks.evidence: 2. 有效主光：默认 legacy forward 中普通 DirectionalLight 只有一个有效主光，即 scene.renderScene.mainLight；最后激活的方向光获选，额外方向光不会叠加照明，也不会各自投射主光阴影。使用 inspectAirDirectionalLights(scene) 检查 mainLight 与 lights[].effective；若 native render scene 尚未建立，会得到 unavailable。第二盏方向光可能触发一次 AIR_W_DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT_LIMIT 警告。需要补光可考虑 Point/Sphere/Spot，而不能依赖第二个普通方向光叠加。依据：[lighting-units.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/lighting-units.md)、[contracts.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/contracts.md)。

answer_checks.criterion: Distinguish main directional/Spot ShadowMap support from Point/Sphere non-support, and Planar from ShadowMap including documented validation limits.
answer_checks.evidence:
3. 阴影支持条件：默认 WebGL2 legacy 管线中，主 DirectionalLight 的 ShadowMap 支持 fixed-area/CSM；CSM 还要求 csmSupported 且 csmLevel>1。Planar 只沿主方向光投影到一个接收平面，并非所有灯光通用。SpotLight 有 shadowEnabled 控制的 ShadowMap 路径；PointLight 不支持阴影生成，SphereLight 无默认阴影路径，RangedDirectionalLight 不属于此主阴影矩阵，Ambient 不产生阴影。不能用 Spot 的结果证明 Point 阴影受支持。依据：[shadow-matrix.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/shadow-matrix.md)。

4. 缺阴影应依次检查四个独立开关：scene.globals.shadows.enabled=true（默认 false）；scene.globals.shadows.type=1（ShadowMap，场景全局默认 Planar=0）；有效主方向光 shadowEnabled=true（默认 false）；投影模型 renderer.shadowCastingMode=MeshRenderer.ShadowCastingMode.ON（默认 OFF）。缺任一个可能静默无阴影、无警告。默认 bundle 没有顶层 ShadowType/PCFType/CSMLevel 导出，故 Code First 可用上述 type ordinal，不能假设能直接 import ShadowType。模型必须有有效 world bounds，否则阴影裁剪队列跳过；检查阴影接收对象/接收平面及投影范围。fixed-area 路径还应核对 shadowNear、shadowFar、shadowOrthoSize 是否覆盖投影物和接收区域；CSM 路径核对 shadowDistance、csmLevel，必要时检查 bias/normalBias。不要把这些方向光专属参数套到 Point/Sphere/Spot。依据：[contracts.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/contracts.md)、[quick-start.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/quick-start.md)、[shadow-matrix.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/shadow-matrix.md)、[common-mistakes.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/common-mistakes.md)。

5. 验证范围：文档记录的主光 ShadowMap 像素证据仅对应 campfire-night 当时固定场景与指纹；Planar 当轮没有获得可判定 ROI 像素变化，Spot 当轮没有单独运行时采样。这些与 API/声明/bundle 可达性应分开，字段写入成功也不等于阴影已显示；当前场景仍需实际浏览器像素和画面检查。依据：[shadow-matrix.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/shadow-matrix.md)、[cocosair-rendering/SKILL.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/SKILL.md)。

answer_checks.criterion: Give all four independent shadow switches: global enabled, ShadowMap type, light shadowEnabled and renderer shadowCastingMode ON; retain world-bounds/culling preconditions.

answer_checks.criterion: Treat source/default-bundle lookups and historical candidate/browser evidence as scoped evidence, not a current runtime pass; provide corresponding document references.
answer_checks.evidence: 5. 验证范围：文档记录的主光 ShadowMap 像素证据仅对应 campfire-night 当时固定场景与指纹；Planar 当轮没有获得可判定 ROI 像素变化，Spot 当轮没有单独运行时采样。这些与 API/声明/bundle 可达性应分开，字段写入成功也不等于阴影已显示；当前场景仍需实际浏览器像素和画面检查。依据：[shadow-matrix.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/references/shadow-matrix.md)、[cocosair-rendering/SKILL.md](skills/cocosair-rendering/SKILL.md)。

errors: Failed or blocked tasks cannot establish benefit
Answer check failed or missing evidence
Both complete load reports must PASS
B1: invalid original or candidate task
